subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: Should OpenClaw accept `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache` as a public compat key and default it for DeepSeek/Xiaomi, narrow the default to live-proven DeepSeek first, or choose the config-free sibling strategy instead?
rationale: Both active strategies target the same P1 provider-cache regression, but adding a public compat/default surface and changing provider-visible prompt layout is a compatibility-sensitive provider policy choice that code inspection alone should not settle.

options.title: Accept this compat/default strategy
options.body: Merge this PR after maintainer approval and exact-head gates, treating the new compat key plus DeepSeek/Xiaomi defaults as the provider-cache mitigation.

options.title: Narrow Xiaomi until proven
options.body: Keep the compat option but default it only for DeepSeek until Xiaomi-specific live or request-shape proof is available.

options.title: Prefer the config-free sibling
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94945 and make that strategy the viable landing path.

recommendation.title: Accept this compat/default strategy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after maintainer approval and exact-head gates, treating the new compat key plus DeepSeek/Xiaomi defaults as the provider-cache mitigation.
